CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_profiles (user_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,username VARCHAR(48) UNIQUE,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX partners_profiles_status(status,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_links (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,code VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL UNIQUE,affiliate_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,product_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,campaign_id VARCHAR(64),channel VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,label VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,active TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,expires_at VARCHAR(40),INDEX partners_links_owner(affiliate_id,created_at),INDEX partners_links_product(product_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_clicks (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,click_seq BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT UNIQUE,affiliate_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,link_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,product_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,visitor_hash VARCHAR(64),user_id VARCHAR(64),eligible TINYINT NOT NULL,consent TINYINT NOT NULL,reason VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,expires_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX partners_clicks_visitor(visitor_hash,product_id,click_seq),INDEX partners_clicks_account(user_id,product_id,click_seq),INDEX partners_clicks_owner(affiliate_id,created_at),INDEX partners_clicks_expiry(expires_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_stores (user_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,username VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL UNIQUE,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX partners_stores_status(status))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_notifications (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,event_key VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL UNIQUE,kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,seen_at VARCHAR(40),INDEX partners_notifications_user(user_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_audit (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,actor_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,action VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,reason VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX partners_audit_user(user_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_fraud_cases (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,affiliate_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX partners_fraud_owner(affiliate_id,status))
